McpServerDefinition.description: Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional data): read-only care team handoff. Writes a handoff for one patient from Salesforce facts with a prompt template. Creates, changes or posts nothing.

tools.descriptionOverride: Read-only. Prepares a care team handoff for ONE Zenthera Patient Support Program patient (demo, fictional): reads the facts from Salesforce records and writes the handoff with a prompt template in fixed sections (summary, patient and therapy, refill status from recorded shipments only, open issues, points to note, non-clinical next steps, data as of). Input: enrollmentNumber (ENR-..., a sentence that contains it also works). Returns resultCode (SUCCESS, AI_UNAVAILABLE = factual handoff shown, INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, ERROR), summary (show exactly as written), resultMessage. Never add facts, never give medical advice, never say whether the patient takes the medication; a safety case appears only as in human safety review. Use it only in a direct message; it never posts to a channel.
